meta.name: add-macos-statusbar
meta.description: Add a macOS menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw. Shows a bolt icon with a green/red dot indicating whether NanoClaw is running, with Start, Stop, and Restart controls. macOS only.

copy.tagline: 在菜单栏显示 NanoClaw 运行状态并控制启停
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 macOS 菜单栏快速查看和切换 NanoClaw 运行状态
copy.tagline_en: Show NanoClaw status and controls in macOS menu bar
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly check and toggle NanoClaw from the macOS menu bar

howto.what: 在 macOS 菜单栏加一个闪电图标,用绿点/红点显示 NanoClaw 是否在运行,并提供 Start、Stop、Restart 控制。会先编译 Swift 二进制,再通过 launchd 加载服务。
howto.when: 当你要求给 NanoClaw 添加 macOS 菜单栏状态指示时触发。仅限 macOS,且需要 swiftc(Xcode Command Line Tools),否则会停下并提示安装。

howto.what_en: Adds a macOS menu bar bolt icon showing whether NanoClaw is running — green dot for running, red dot for stopped — with Start, Stop, and Restart controls. It compiles a Swift binary and loads a launchd agent. macOS only.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask to add a macOS menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw. Requires macOS and swiftc (Xcode Command Line Tools); it stops and tells you otherwise.
